note: Made by the export of src/cite/atlas.ts (ASSETS.md). Sizes and places are in 1x pixels; the 2x sheets hold every cell at twice the size, lit again at twice the scale. A group is a grid of w x h cells with 1 pixel between cells: a row a direction (or a season), a column a frame. anchor: the foot of the sprite in a cell. generator: a hash of the drawing code and its light; when it differs from the build the sheets are stale and the sprites are baked from the generators instead.
